task.description:
Rework 1 — Fix TC-DDL-04-AC6 to actually assert the adaptive backfill_batch_size (ISS-0716 AC1).

Problem (from TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR): TC-DDL-04-AC6 uses defaultConfig() which never triggers halving. The assertion backfill_batch_size='5000' is indistinguishable from the pre-fix hardcoded state.

Fix: Add a second assertion block to TC-DDL-04-AC6 (or a separate TC-DDL-04-AC6b) that:
1. Uses a halving-triggering config (batch_timeout_ms=1 as in TC-DDL-04-AC4) so the adaptive batch_size halves to 2500 or lower.
2. After the run, queries plat_migration_state.backfill_batch_size from the DB.
3. Asserts the persisted backfill_batch_size is 2500 (or the actual halved value, not 5000).

Also update tests/specs/DDL-04.md to document this additional assertion.

Run zig build + ddl04 integration tests. Commit and push to feature/WF03-GH814-20260817.

result.summary: Added TC-DDL-04-AC6b-persists-halved-batch-size: uses halving config (batch_timeout_ms=1, 6000 rows) and asserts plat_migration_state.backfill_batch_size=1250 (the final adaptive value, not the initial default 5000). Pre-fix code hardcoded 5000 in recordBatchProgress; the new assertion distinguishes pre-fix from post-fix. Updated tests/specs/DDL-04.md acceptance criteria table and added TC-DDL-04-AC6b test case spec. All 7 DDL-04 backfill integration tests pass (zig build exits 0).
result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR for re-validation of TC-DDL-04-AC6b
